notes: Reformed/complementarian congregation in the Sovereign Grace Churches network, meeting Sundays at 10am on W Ina Rd. Sermons are published weekly to a YouTube channel and to podcast feeds - one of the easier Tucson churches to pull a clean sermon corpus from. Ernie Blanco is confirmed as a sermon speaker (29 March 2026) from the podcast feed. The leadership page describes a senior pastor named 'Derek' who does most of the preaching, but his surname was not visible in any search snippet, so he is NOT recorded - retrieve it from sovgracetucson.org/leadership/ and add him.
